scope: SSc biomarkers detection in the secretome of TGFβ1-activated primary human lung fibroblasts.
we identified 37 differentially secreted proteins in the conditioned media of TGFβ1-activated NL fibroblasts

To examine the effects of TGFβ1 stimulation on the secretome of NL fibroblasts, fibroblasts were grown to about 50% confluency, washed with serum-free media (DMEM with no additives), and incubated in serum-free media with either 10 ng/mL TGFβ1 or vehicle (4 mM HCl, 0.1% bovine serum albumin) for 72 hours before the lysates and conditioned media were harvested.
The conditioned media were centrifuged 1,000 x g for 5 minutes to pellet cell debris. The media were concentrated 100-fold using a centrifugal spin filter with a 5 KDa molecular weight cutoff
